facts.summary: Mixed interim NASH results; NASH program halted, pivot to IBD · Phase 2a · MET642 in NASH · not yet approved

evidence.summary: we have made the decision to focus Metacrine’s clinical development effort and financial resources on moving MET642 into a Phase 2 trial in IBD in the first half of 2022 and to halt future development of the FXR program in NASH.
evidence.safety: MET642 was generally well-tolerated, with no treatment-related serious adverse events (AEs).
evidence.program_discontinued: to halt future development of the FXR program in NASH
